275900730.description: This pair of natural agate geode bookends features a rough exterior and a polished interior that reveals gray, white, and brown crystalline formations. The interior showcases sparkling quartz crystals and banded agate layers, creating a unique and attractive appearance. The felted bases help protect surfaces from scratches, although one base has a Goodwill price sticker attached. There are no visible cracks or chips on the geodes.

275455471.description:
This lot includes 15 assorted polished and raw gemstones and mineral specimens. The collection features a variety of colors and types, including rose quartz (pink), amethyst (purple), agate (pink/red), tiger's eye (brown/black), and possibly sodalite (blue/white). Each stone varies in size, approximately 1-3 cm, with some stones tumbled and others in natural raw form. All specimens are in very good condition with no visible chips or cracks. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or crafting projects.
